actions.add_customers_to_group.descripti: Adds one or more customers to a customer group. Their other groups stay as they are.
actions.add_customers_to_group.props.cus: Numeric customer IDs, one per row, for example 1227534533. Map them from a trigger or from Find Customers, or copy one from the end of the customer page link in the Salla dashboard.
actions.add_customers_to_group.props.gro: The group to add the customers to, for example VIP Customers. In a flow, map the numeric group ID, for example 1226617469.
actions.add_order_note.description: Adds a note to the order history without changing its status.
actions.add_order_note.props.note.descri: Text to add to the order history, for example "Customer asked to deliver after 5 PM."
actions.add_order_note.props.order.descr: Pick an order or search by reference number, customer name or mobile. In a flow, map the order ID (for example 2116149737), not the reference number customers see.
actions.add_product_image.description: Adds one image to a product from a file or a public link, keeping its other images. A product can have up to 10 images.
actions.add_product_image.props.alt.desc: Short image description for screen readers and search engines, for example "Red cotton T-shirt, front view".
actions.add_product_image.props.file.des: JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP image up to 10 MB, for example shirt-front.jpg. Needed when Image Source is File.
actions.add_product_image.props.main.des: Yes makes this the main product image. Leave on Salla default to add it after the current images.
Pick a product or search by name or SKU. In a flow, map the numeric product ID (for example 1672932878).
actions.add_product_image.props.sort.des: Position of the image in the gallery, a whole number where 1 comes first, for example 2.
actions.add_product_image.props.source.d: Upload a file (for example the output of a previous step) or give a public link such as https://cdn.example.com/shirt-front.jpg.
actions.add_product_image.props.url.desc: Public image link that starts with https://, for example https://cdn.example.com/shirt-front.jpg. Needed when Image Source is URL.
actions.adjust_stock.description: Adds units to, removes units from, or sets the stock of a product or variant. Salla queues the change, so it can take a few minutes to show in the store.
actions.adjust_stock.props.branch.descri: Branch or warehouse whose stock changes. Leave empty for the store default. In a flow, map the numeric branch ID, for example 1473353380.
actions.adjust_stock.props.find_by.descr: Product for a product without options, Variant for one option combination such as Red / M, or SKU (works for both, for example TSHIRT-RED-M).
actions.adjust_stock.props.mode.descript: Add (increment) or Remove (decrement) units from the current stock, or Set (overwrite) the stock to the quantity below.
actions.adjust_stock.props.product.descr: Needed when Find By is Product or Variant. Pick it or search by name or SKU. In a flow, map the numeric product ID, for example 1672932878.
actions.adjust_stock.props.quantity.desc: Whole number of units. Above 0 for Add and Remove, for example 5; 0 or more for Set.
actions.adjust_stock.props.reason.descri: Why the stock changed, saved in the Salla quantity history, for example Restock or Damaged. In a flow, map the numeric reason ID.
actions.adjust_stock.props.sku.descripti: SKU of the product or variant, for example TSHIRT-RED-M. Needed when Find By is SKU.
actions.adjust_stock.props.variant.descr: Needed when Find By is Variant. Lists the variants of the product above. In a flow, map the numeric variant ID, for example 1980012345.
actions.ai_add_customers_to_group.descri: Adds one or more customers to a customer group.
Numeric Salla customer IDs from List Customers, at least one, for example ["1209983424", "1462397105"].
Numeric customer group ID from List Customer Groups, for example 1227534533.
actions.ai_add_product_image.description: Adds one image to a product from a public URL. A product can have up to 10 images.
actions.ai_add_product_image.props.alt.d: Text that describes the image for search engines and screen readers, for example Red cotton T-shirt, back view.
actions.ai_add_product_image.props.image: Public link to a JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP image starting with https://, for example https://cdn.example.com/shirt-back.jpg.
yes makes this the product's main image, no adds it as an extra image, default lets Salla decide. Default default.
actions.ai_add_product_image.props.produ: Numeric Salla product ID, for example 1672932878. Find it with List Products.
Position among the product images, a whole number where 1 is first, for example 2.
actions.ai_adjust_stock.description: Adds, removes or sets stock for one or more products or variants.
actions.ai_adjust_stock.props.lines.desc: One entry per product or variant, for example [{"identifier_type":"sku","identifier":"TSHIRT-RED-M","quantity":5,"mode":"increment"},{"identifier_type":"variant_id","identifier":"1395346624","quantity":0,"mode":"overwrite","branch_id":999858679}]. identifier_type is id (product ID), variant_id or sku; mode is increment (add), decrement (remove) or overwrite (set to exactly quantity).
actions.ai_create_coupon.description: Creates a new discount coupon in the store.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.amount.de: Discount size, above 0, for example 10 for 10% (at most 100) or 10 SAR off for a fixed coupon.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.applied_i: Where the coupon works: all, web (store website) or app (store mobile app). Leave empty for the Salla default.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.apply_wit: yes lets the coupon combine with the store's special offers, no does not, default keeps the Salla default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.code.desc: Code customers type at checkout, letters and digits with no spaces, for example SUMMER10. Must not be used by another coupon.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.exclude_b: Numeric brand IDs from List Brands the coupon never applies to, for example ["1473353380"].
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.exclude_c: Numeric category IDs from List Categories the coupon never applies to, for example ["752848962"].
Numeric customer group IDs from List Customer Groups that cannot use the coupon, for example ["1227534533"].
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.exclude_p: Numeric product IDs from List Products the coupon never applies to, for example ["1672932878"].
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.exclude_s: yes stops the coupon from applying to products that already have a sale price, no lets it apply. Default no.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.expiry_da: Last day the coupon works, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, for example 2026-12-31. A date with no time works until 23:59:59 that day. Must be at least tomorrow.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.free_ship: yes also makes shipping free for orders using the coupon, no does not. Default no.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.include_c: Numeric category IDs from List Categories the coupon applies to, for example ["1340423950"]. Leave empty for all categories.
Numeric customer group IDs from List Customer Groups that can use the coupon, for example ["1227534533"]. Leave empty for all customers.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.include_p: Numeric product IDs from List Products the coupon applies to, for example ["1672932878"]. Leave empty for all products.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.maximum_a: Cap on the discount, in the store currency, for example 50. Required when type is percentage; ignored for fixed coupons.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.minimum_a: Smallest cart total, in the store currency, that can use the coupon, for example 100.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.payment_m: Payment methods the coupon works with, any of: all, apple_pay, bank, cod, credit_card, knet, mada, paypal, spotii_pay, stc_pay, tabby_installment, tamara_installment, for example ["mada", "credit_card"]. Leave empty for the Salla default.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.show_maxi: yes shows maximum_amount to customers, no hides it, default keeps the Salla default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.start_dat: First day the coupon works, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS, for example 2026-12-01. Must be before expiry_date. Leave empty to start now.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.status.de: active or inactive. Leave empty for the Salla default.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.type.desc: percentage takes amount percent off, fixed takes amount in the store currency off. For example percentage.
actions.ai_create_coupon.props.usage_lim: How many times the coupon can be used in total, a whole number, for example 100. Leave empty for no limit.
How many times one customer can use the coupon, a whole number, for example 1. Leave empty for no limit.
actions.ai_create_customer.description: Creates a new customer in the store.
actions.ai_create_customer.props.birthda: Date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1994-03-21. Salla accepts it but may not save it, so it can come back empty.
actions.ai_create_customer.props.country: Two-letter country code of the customer, for example SA. Needed when the mobile starts with +1 or +7, or with a calling code the piece does not recognise; otherwise it is worked out from the mobile.
actions.ai_create_customer.props.email.d: Email address, for example sara@example.com. Must not belong to another customer in the store.
actions.ai_create_customer.props.first_n: Customer first name, for example Sara.
male or female. Leave empty to not set it. Salla accepts it but may not save it, so it can come back empty.
actions.ai_create_customer.props.group_i: Numeric customer group IDs from List Customer Groups, for example ["1227534533"]. Leave empty for no group.
actions.ai_create_customer.props.last_na: Customer last name, for example Al-Qahtani.
Mobile number with the country code, for example +966501234567. Must not belong to another customer in the store.
actions.ai_create_customer.props.mobile_: Calling code of the mobile, for example +966. Needed only when the country code cannot be told from the mobile; leave empty when the mobile starts with +966 or another common code.
actions.ai_create_order.description: Creates a new order for an existing or new customer.
actions.ai_create_order.props.accepted_m: Payment method the customer may use to pay later: credit_card, mada, bank or cod. Required when payment_status is pending_payment.
Numeric branch ID from List Branches, for example 999858679. Required when delivery_method is pickup.
actions.ai_create_order.props.cash_on_de: Optional fee for cash on delivery, for example 10. Used only when payment_method is cod. Leave empty for no fee. The store currency is used automatically.
actions.ai_create_order.props.coupon_cod: Store coupon code to apply, for example SUMMER20.
actions.ai_create_order.props.courier_id: Numeric ID of the store's shipping company, for example 1433878184. Required when delivery_method is shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.customer_e: Email of a new customer, for example sara@example.com. Used only when customer_id is empty.
actions.ai_create_order.props.customer_i: Numeric ID of an existing Salla customer, for example 1209983424. Leave empty to create the order for a new customer with customer_name and customer_mobile.
actions.ai_create_order.props.customer_m: Mobile number of a new customer in international format, for example +966500000000. Required when customer_id is empty.
actions.ai_create_order.props.customer_n: Full name of a new customer, for example Sara Al-Qahtani. Required when customer_id is empty.
actions.ai_create_order.props.delivery_m: shipping (then set courier_id, every ship_to_* field, and latitude and longitude) or pickup (then set branch_id). Required when any product needs shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.latitude.d: Latitude of the delivery point in decimal degrees, for example 24.6888248. Required for shipping, together with longitude: Salla rejects a shipping address without coordinates.
Longitude of the delivery point in decimal degrees, for example 46.686327. Required for shipping, together with latitude: Salla rejects a shipping address without coordinates.
actions.ai_create_order.props.payment_me: How the order was paid: credit_card, mada, bank, cod or subscription. Required when payment_status is paid, and then it must be bank or cod.
actions.ai_create_order.props.payment_re: Required when payment_method is bank (the store bank account ID, for example 234234) or subscription (the subscription ID).
actions.ai_create_order.props.payment_st: paid when the customer already paid (then set payment_method to bank or cod; Salla accepts paid only with those two), pending_payment when Salla should wait for payment (then set accepted_method, which is required).
actions.ai_create_order.props.products.d: One entry per product line, for example [{"identifier_type":"sku","identifier":"TSHIRT-RED-M","quantity":2},{"identifier_type":"id","identifier":"515303061","quantity":1}]. identifier_type is id (numeric Salla product ID) or sku; quantity defaults to 1.
actions.ai_create_order.props.receipt_im: Public URL of the bank transfer receipt, for example https://cdn.example.com/receipts/41027662.jpg. Required when payment_method is bank.
actions.ai_create_order.props.receiver_c: Two-letter ISO country code of the receiver phone, for example SA.
actions.ai_create_order.props.receiver_n: Name of the person receiving the order when it is not the customer, for example Ahmed Al-Harbi.
yes tells Salla to notify the receiver about the order, no does not, default sends nothing and keeps Salla's default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_order.props.receiver_p: Receiver phone in international format, for example +966566666666.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_ad: Saudi National Address additional number, 4 digits, for example 6558. Required for Saudi addresses.
Full street address, for example 7124 Prince Sultan Road, Al Olaya, Riyadh. Required for shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_bl: Neighbourhood or block name, for example Al Olaya. Required for shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_bu: Saudi National Address building number, 4 digits, for example 7124. Required for Saudi addresses.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_ci: Salla city ID, for example 1939592358. Required for shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_co: Salla country ID (a Salla number, not an ISO code). Required for shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_di: Salla district ID, for example 1939592358. Required for shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_po: Postal code, 5 digits in Saudi Arabia, for example 12211. Required for shipping.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_sh: Saudi National Address short code, 4 letters and 4 digits, for example JCMA3429. Required for Saudi addresses.
actions.ai_create_order.props.ship_to_st: Street number or name, for example 8230. Required for shipping.
actions.ai_create_product.description: Creates a new product in the store.
actions.ai_create_product.props.brand_id: Numeric brand ID from List Brands, for example 1473353380.
actions.ai_create_product.props.calories: Calories for food products, for example 250.
actions.ai_create_product.props.category: Numeric category IDs from List Categories, for example ["1340423950", "752848962"]. Leave empty for no category.
actions.ai_create_product.props.cost_pri: What the product costs the merchant, for reports only, for example 40.
actions.ai_create_product.props.descript:
Product description, plain text or HTML, for example

Soft cotton, regular fit.

.
actions.ai_create_product.props.enable_n: yes lets customers write a note for this product, no does not, default keeps the Salla default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_product.props.enable_u: yes lets customers attach an image to their order of this product, no does not, default keeps the Salla default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_product.props.gtin.des: Global trade item number or barcode, for example 6281000000012.
actions.ai_create_product.props.hide_qua: yes hides the stock count from customers, no shows it, default keeps the Salla default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_product.props.image_ur: Public image links starting with https://, up to 10 images, for example ["https://cdn.example.com/shirt-front.jpg"]. The first one becomes the main image.
actions.ai_create_product.props.maximum_: Most units one customer can buy in one order, a whole number, for example 3.
actions.ai_create_product.props.metadata: Page description for search engines, for example Soft cotton T-shirt in 5 colours.
Page title for search engines, for example Cotton T-Shirt | My Store.
Custom URL slug for the product page, for example cotton-t-shirt.
actions.ai_create_product.props.mpn.desc: Manufacturer part number, for example MPN-44521.
actions.ai_create_product.props.name.des: Product name shown in the store, for example Cotton T-Shirt.
actions.ai_create_product.props.price.de: Regular price in the store currency, 0 or more, for example 99.5.
actions.ai_create_product.props.product_: One of: product, service, group_products, codes, digital, food, booking, donating. Use product for a physical item that ships, for example product. It cannot be changed after the product is created.
actions.ai_create_product.props.promotio: Promotion text on the product page, for example Free shipping over 200 SAR.
Badge text on the product card, for example New.
actions.ai_create_product.props.quantity: Units in stock, a whole number, for example 25. Ignored when unlimited_quantity is yes.
actions.ai_create_product.props.require_: yes when the product must be shipped, no when it is not (services, digital), default keeps the Salla default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_product.props.sale_end: Last day of the sale price, format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-31.
actions.ai_create_product.props.sale_pri: Discounted price, lower than price, for example 79. Leave empty for no sale.
actions.ai_create_product.props.sale_sta: First day of the sale price, format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-01.
actions.ai_create_product.props.sku.desc: Unique stock code for the product, for example TSHIRT-RED-M.
actions.ai_create_product.props.status.d: sale (on sale), out (out of stock) or hidden. Leave empty for the Salla default. sale needs at least one image in image_urls.
actions.ai_create_product.props.subtitle: Short line shown under the name, for example 100% cotton.
Subtitle
actions.ai_create_product.props.unlimite: yes means stock is never counted, no means quantity is tracked, default keeps the Salla default. Default default.
actions.ai_create_product.props.weight.d: Shipping weight in weight_type units, for example 0.5.
actions.ai_create_product.props.weight_t: Unit of weight, one of: kg, g, lb, oz, for example kg.
actions.ai_list_abandoned_carts.descript: Lists carts customers left without checking out.
actions.ai_list_abandoned_carts.props.ke: Customer ID or mobile number to match, for example 1209983424 or +966501234567. Leave empty for all carts.
actions.ai_list_abandoned_carts.props.ma: Maximum number of carts to return, from 1 to 200, for example 20. Default 20.
actions.ai_list_abandoned_carts.props.ol: Sent to Salla as offset, a whole number of minutes, for example 60. Salla documents it as "carts created within or before an offset time"; the exact direction is unconfirmed. Leave empty for no offset filter.
actions.ai_list_branches.description: Lists the store branches and warehouses.
actions.ai_list_branches.props.keyword.d: Optional text to match in the branch name, for example Riyadh. Leave empty to list all branches.
actions.ai_list_brands.props.keyword.des: Optional text to match in the brand name, for example Nike. Leave empty to list all brands.
actions.ai_list_categories.props.keyword: Optional text to match in the category name, for example Shirts. Leave empty to list all categories.
actions.ai_list_coupons.description: Lists store coupons that match the given filters.
actions.ai_list_coupons.props.created_fr: Only coupons created on or after this day, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-01.
actions.ai_list_coupons.props.created_to: Only coupons created on or before this day, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-30.
actions.ai_list_coupons.props.expires_fr: Only coupons expiring on or after this day, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-01.
actions.ai_list_coupons.props.expires_to: Only coupons expiring on or before this day, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-31.
actions.ai_list_coupons.props.keyword.de: Text to match in the coupon code, for example SUMMER10. Leave empty for all coupons.
actions.ai_list_coupons.props.max_result: Maximum number of coupons to return, from 1 to 200, for example 20. Default 20.
actions.ai_list_customer_groups.descript: Lists the customer groups in the store.
actions.ai_list_customers.description: Lists store customers that match the given filters.
actions.ai_list_customers.props.date_fro: Sent as Salla's date_from filter, a day in store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-01. Salla's docs disagree on whether date_from is the start or the end of the range, so check the dates in the results.
Sent as Salla's date_to filter, a day in store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-30. Salla's docs disagree on whether date_to is the start or the end of the range, so check the dates in the results.
Search over customer mobile, email or name, for example +966501234567, sara@example.com or Sara. Leave empty for all customers.
actions.ai_list_customers.props.max_resu: Maximum number of customers to return, from 1 to 200, for example 20. Default 20.
actions.ai_list_order_statuses.descripti: Lists the order statuses of the store, built-in and custom.
actions.ai_list_orders.description: Lists store orders that match the given filters.
Numeric branch IDs from List Branches, for example ["999858679"]. Leave empty for all branches.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.customer_id: Numeric Salla customer ID, for example 1209983424. Returns only that customer's orders.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.from_date.d: Only orders created on or after this day, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-01.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.keyword.des: Free-text search over customer mobile, customer name, shipping number, reference number and tag name, for example +966500000000 or Sara.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.max_results: Maximum number of orders to return, from 1 to 200, for example 20. Default 20.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.payment_met: Payment method slugs from List Payment Methods, for example ["mada", "cod"]. Matches orders paid with any of them. Leave empty for all.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.reference_i: The order number the merchant and customer see, for example 41027662. It is not the internal order id (2116149737); use this filter to find the internal id from the number a customer quotes.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.sort_by.des: Field Salla sorts the results by: id, total, updated_at or created_at. Leave empty for Salla's default order.
Numeric order status IDs from List Order Statuses, for example ["566146469"]. Matches orders in any of them. Leave empty for all statuses.
actions.ai_list_orders.props.to_date.des: Only orders created on or before this day, store time (Asia/Riyadh), format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-30.
actions.ai_list_payment_methods.descript: Lists the payment methods available to the store.
actions.ai_list_products.description: Lists store products that match the given filters.
actions.ai_list_products.props.category_: Numeric category ID from List Categories, for example 1340423950. Returns only products in that category.
actions.ai_list_products.props.keyword.d: Free-text search over product name and SKU, for example T-Shirt or TSHIRT-RED-M. Leave empty for all products.
actions.ai_list_products.props.max_resul: Maximum number of products to return, from 1 to 200, for example 20. Default 20.
actions.ai_list_products.props.status.de: Only products with this status: sale (on sale), out (out of stock) or hidden. Leave empty for all statuses.
actions.ai_list_stock_change_reasons.des: Lists the reasons the store offers for a stock change.
actions.ai_update_customer.description: Changes the details of an existing customer.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.birthda: New date of birth, format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1994-03-21. Salla accepts it but may not save it, and any update can clear a birthday saved earlier.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.country: Two-letter country code of the customer, for example SA. Needed with a new mobile when it starts with +1 or +7, or with a calling code the piece does not recognise.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.custome: Numeric Salla customer ID, for example 1227534533. Find it with List Customers.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.email.d: New email address, for example sara@example.com.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.first_n: New first name, for example Sara.
male or female. Leave empty to keep the current gender. Salla accepts it but may not save it, so it can come back empty.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.group_i: Numeric customer group IDs from List Customer Groups, for example ["1227534533"]. Salla's docs do not say whether this replaces the current groups or adds to them; Add Customers to Group adds without touching other groups. Leave empty to keep the current groups.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.last_na: New last name, for example Al-Qahtani.
New mobile number with the country code, for example +966501234567.
actions.ai_update_customer.props.mobile_: Calling code of the new mobile, for example +966. Use it only together with mobile, and only when the country code cannot be told from the mobile.
actions.ai_update_order.description: Changes customer, receiver, shipping, payment, coupon or assigned employees on an order.
actions.ai_update_order.props.accepted_m: Comma-separated payment method slugs the customer may pay with, for example bank, credit_card. Leave empty to keep them unchanged.
Numeric branch ID from List Branches, for example 999858679.
actions.ai_update_order.props.cash_on_de: Optional fee for cash on delivery, for example 10. Used only when payment_method is cod. Leave empty for no fee. The store currency is used automatically.
actions.ai_update_order.props.coupon_cod: Store coupon code to apply, for example SUMMER20.
actions.ai_update_order.props.courier_id: Numeric ID of the store's shipping company, for example 1433878184.
actions.ai_update_order.props.customer_e: Not supported, leave empty: Salla cannot change a customer's email from an order. Use Update Customer.
actions.ai_update_order.props.customer_i: Numeric ID of an existing Salla customer to move the order to, for example 1209983424. Find it with List Customers. Leave empty to keep the current customer.
actions.ai_update_order.props.customer_m: Not supported, leave empty: Salla cannot change a customer's mobile from an order. Use Update Customer.
actions.ai_update_order.props.customer_n: Not supported, leave empty: Salla cannot change a customer's name from an order. Use Update Customer.
actions.ai_update_order.props.delivery_m: shipping or pickup. Leave empty to keep the current method.
actions.ai_update_order.props.employee_i: Comma-separated numeric IDs of store employees to assign, for example 1764372897, 1298199463. Leave empty to keep the assignment unchanged.
actions.ai_update_order.props.latitude.d: Latitude of the delivery point in decimal degrees, for example 24.6888248. Required when changing the address, together with longitude and every ship_to_* field.
Longitude of the delivery point in decimal degrees, for example 46.686327. Required when changing the address, together with latitude and every ship_to_* field.
actions.ai_update_order.props.order_id.d: Internal order ID, the long number (2116149737), not the reference number customers see (41027662). Find it with List Orders using reference_id.
actions.ai_update_order.props.payment_me: Payment method slug, for example bank, cod, mada or credit_card. See List Payment Methods for the store's slugs.
actions.ai_update_order.props.payment_st: paid or pending_payment. Leave empty to keep it. Salla changes payment only while the order is pending.
actions.ai_update_order.props.receipt_im: Public URL of the bank transfer receipt, for example https://cdn.example.com/receipts/41027662.jpg.
actions.ai_update_order.props.receiver_c: Two-letter ISO country code of the receiver phone, for example SA.

auth.description:
Salla connects through your own private app. It is free and takes about 5 minutes to set up.

**Step 1 · Create the app**
In the [Salla Partners Portal](https://portal.salla.partners), go to **My Apps** → **Create App** and choose **Private** and **General**.

**Step 2 · Turn on login**
In the app, open **App Details** → **App Settings**:
- **OAuth Mode:** Custom Mode
- **Callback URLs:** paste this URL, then save

```text
{{redirectUrl}}
```

**Step 3 · Tick the permissions** (under **App Scopes**)
- **Read & write:** Orders, Products, Customers, Marketing, Webhooks
- **Read:** Categories, Brands, Abandoned Carts, Reviews, Payments, Branches

**Step 4 · Give the app access to your store**
- **To test:** under **App Testing**, click **Create Demo Store**, then **Install App**.
- **Your live store:** under **Merchant Store Access Requests**, add your store URL, then approve the request as the store owner.

**Step 5 · Connect**
Copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** from **App Keys** into the fields below, click **Connect**, and approve in the Salla window.

**Good to know:** if you tick a new permission later, or the connection sits unused for a month, reconnect it.

description: Saudi e-commerce platform for online stores: manage orders, products, stock, customers and coupons, and react to store events.
triggers.abandoned_cart.description: Triggers when a shopper leaves items in a cart without paying (also when that cart changes later), or when an abandoned cart is recovered and paid.
triggers.abandoned_cart.props.event.desc: Which cart event starts the flow. Salla sends "Cart abandoned or changed" when an abandoned cart is created and each time it is updated. To catch both events, use two flows.
triggers.abandoned_cart.props.rule.descr: Optional condition Salla checks before sending the event, so the flow only runs for matching carts. Works only with "Cart abandoned or changed"; Salla does not filter recovered carts. Put text values in backticks. Examples: `total > 200` or ``coupon_code = `WELCOME20` ``. Cart fields you can use include id, total, subtotal, currency, coupon_code, customer_id, customer_name and customer_mobile.
triggers.any_store_event.description: Triggers on any Salla store event you pick, such as shipments, brands, categories, special offers or branches. Use it for events that have no trigger of their own. Salla has retired product.updated and product.available; use Product Price or Status Changed instead.
triggers.any_store_event.props.event.des: The Salla event that starts the flow. The list comes from your store. Salla has retired product.updated and product.available, so they are refused even if they still show here; use Product Price or Status Changed instead.
triggers.any_store_event.props.rule.desc: Optional condition Salla checks before sending the event, so the flow only runs for matching records. Put text values in backticks, for example `total > 100` or ``status = `active` ``. The fields depend on the event. Salla supports rules only on order, customer, special offer, category, brand, abandoned cart and review events, plus product created, deleted and low stock; leave this empty for any other event.
triggers.customer_updated.description: Triggers when a customer's profile changes in the Salla store.
triggers.customer_updated.props.rule.des: Optional condition Salla checks before sending the event, so the flow only runs for matching customers. Put text values in backticks, written in the store language, which is Arabic by default. Examples: ``gender = `female` `` or ``city = `الرياض` ``. Customer fields you can use include id, first_name, last_name, mobile, mobile_code, email, gender, city, country and currency.

triggers.new_customer.props.rule.descrip: Optional condition Salla checks before sending the event, so the flow only runs for matching customers. Customer fields you can use include id, first_name, last_name, mobile, mobile_code, email, gender, city, country and currency.
triggers.new_order.description: Triggers when a customer or the merchant places a new order in the Salla store.
triggers.new_order.props.rule.descriptio: Optional condition Salla checks before sending the event, so the flow only runs for matching orders. Put text values in backticks. Examples: `total > 100` or ``payment_method = `mada` AND total > 50``. Order fields you can use include id, reference_id, customer_id, status_id, branch_id, coupon_code, total, sub_total, shipping_cost, payment_method and currency.
